scope: actual packet26 sources and generated checked imported GEMV mirrors; CPU static inspection only

findings.finding: Class lookup does not normalize blk.<layer>. prefix; attn.combine/ffn.combine and per-class GEMV table keys miss real plan sites unless every exact label is emitted.
findings.remedy: Exact label first, then normalized class, then generic Op fallback; GEMV should similarly normalize.
findings.resolution: Reviewed class_name() prefix removal and new_for/gemv_for exact-label then class lookup in current dispatch.hpp.

findings.finding: Capture recognizer accepts [&]; sizeof closure guard alone cannot mechanically enforce by-value capture.
findings.remedy: Reject reference-capture device closures and add negative checker test. Existing inspected closures all use [=].
findings.resolution: Reviewed kernel_gate.py explicit assertion rejecting [&] device closures. All other unsupported capture forms remain fail-closed through recognizer.

findings.finding: Additional packet25 GEMV names cannot be enabled as table edit alone: only existing 0..7 variants are registered and unknown names throw.
findings.remedy: Register/link supported packet25 candidate names before advertising table-only adoption, or clearly record unavailable candidates.

findings.finding: Production route selects SimpleNew with runtime n/top; specialised_submit fixed route<512> applies to fixture API, not production route path.
findings.remedy: Instantiate production fixed width/top constants for model geometry, retaining variable tiny/odd-fixture fallback.
findings.resolution: Reviewed SimpleNew/submit/body FixedN/FixedTop templates and production host choice simple_new_submit<Op::route,512,10>; mini/odd shapes retain fallback.

observations: New candidates select Op and Stage/Phase with templates and if constexpr; no new Batch/Chain kernel found.
No hot parameter block uploaded to device or dereferenced through device pointer found; data, scratch, RoPE, route records remain legitimate buffers.
Imported GEMV mirror packet6/7/8 captures one descriptor by value, removes descriptor search, and specializes Type template; its fixed single-matrix metadata is not a command interpreter.

Packet9 proven expert projection uses one/two matching matrices and explicit type template; frozen Core evaluator, Glue and ng::group are baseline/reference paths and are not newly introduced candidate interpreters.
limits: Compilation was already running elsewhere; object list is a snapshot, not a final linked-binary attestation.
No device binary was executed. No speed or byte identity verdict inferred from this architecture review.
remaining_limitation: Future packet25 implementation names are not yet linked; current table supports the existing arithmetic kernel names only.
